predeclared: 2026-10-26, before any version-7 data were generated. The protocol and research/confirm.py were committed together (the commit that adds this file), and a run records its git HEAD and refuses to start with uncommitted changes to the package, the script or this file.
phase: Confirmation of the frozen 0.2.0 procedure on fresh seeds. Results do not change the procedure.

procedure.call: wade.wade(counts, cond, direction='both', pvalues='auto', relative_error=0.2, max_permutations=999999, fdr=0.05, normalization=RLE fit on the complete matrix, test_genes=wade.filter_counts(counts, min_count=3, min_samples=2), seed=permutation_seed[, strata=study])
procedure.frozen: the normalization (one size factor per sample), the depth equalization (binomial thinning to the smallest size factor, per stratum with strata), the subset test (thinning by the Wasserstein-1 fold, four thinning draws, validated range 32 reads), the filtering, the direction (both), Monte Carlo stopping (Besag-Clifford at 25 exceedances, decision-based at fdr), and both statistics
procedure.per_gene_arms: each gene has its own labelling, which wade() cannot take, so these arms run the functions wade() runs, with its settings and every run finished (fdr=None): the area test's saddlepoint, shuffled where its error estimate exceeds relative_error, and the subset test. A preflight checks them against wade() itself, with and without strata, and the run stops if they differ.

rule.decision: Each check passes unless its estimate is significantly above the acceptable value, one-sided at familywise_false_fail / checks: an exact binomial test for shares (of independent null tests, or of matrices), a t test over matrices for mean proportions. A check also needs power >= 0.9 at the unacceptable value, computed at its realized size (exact binomial power zigzags with the size, so 'size' is the smallest size that reaches it); a check without it is reported as underpowered and does not pass.
rule.acceptable_and_unacceptable: per-gene null rates and false discovery proportions: acceptable at the nominal level, unacceptable at 1.5 times it; the chance of any discovery under the complete null: unacceptable at twice the level; the union of the two tests' lists: acceptable at twice the level, unacceptable at three times it (author's decision, 2026-10-26)
rule.no_zero_event_rules: every check is sized by the rule above; none passes by observing no events
rule.dependence: the per-gene arms give each gene its own random labelling; their null tests share samples, which the binomial test ignores

generator.retired: bulk_half_subset_up_10pct_4x: below the information limit (2026-09-27 review); replaced by the 8-1024x raised-subset series

simulated.comparator: Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene (asymptotic, tie-corrected) on the same normalized counts and test mask; one BH family over the tested genes, as for WADE; a call's side is the sign of U - n1*n0/2
simulated.null: Independent biological patients; exposures independent of condition; no injected group confounding
simulated.power: descriptive: the share of each profile x abundance called on its intended side and on the other, for the area test, the subset test and the comparator
simulated.seeds: matrix seed [seed_root, allocation, panel, replicate], permutation seed [..., 97], as protocol version 6; the preflight uses [seed_root, 199, ...]

count_model.reference: research/count_model.py dataset(): TCGA prostate tumours, a random split per gene, thinned binomially by design; data set k (in the order designs x depths x arms, from 1) seeded seed_root x 1000 + k; tests seeded [seed_root, 101, k]
count_model.arms_note: [fold, exposure]; 'cohort' is the TCGA prostate design's own exposure imbalance (median tumour over median normal size factor)
count_model.bins: expected reads per sample in the sparser group: level x depth x min(p1, p0)

real_labels.labels: the cohort's tumours, a random split per gene into the design, seeded [seed_root, 102, cohort, design]; tests seeded [seed_root, 102, cohort, design, 97]; the cohort's own RLE size factors
real_labels.bins: the lower group's mean normalized count

strata.simulated_studies: research/strata.py model_dataset(): the two designs of MODEL_DESIGNS, batch sd 0 and 0.5; folds 1 (both tests), 1.5 and 3 (the subset test)
strata.sites: TCGA prostate tumours relabelled within their sites with 4+ tumours, a quarter or three quarters pseudo-cases by size order; folds 1 and 1.5
strata.layout: the real contrast's five sites, their tumours relabelled with the real design's case shares; folds 1 and 1.5
strata.gtex: TCGA normal-adjacent and GTEx prostate normals, relabelled within study, three quarters and a quarter pseudo-cases
strata.seeds: data set k (simulated studies first, then sites, layout, gtex): gene picks and relabellings from [seed_root, 103, k]; simulated studies generated with seed seed_root x 1000 + k; tests seeded [seed_root, 103, k, 97]
strata.tests: both tests with the strata as codes (wade(..., strata=study))
strata.bins: simulated studies: each gene's smallest expected reads over the strata's groups; real nulls: the lower group's mean normalized count

arms.biology: descriptive: the TCGA notebooks' recovery of ERG, ETV1, ETV4 and FLI1 fusions and ERBB2 amplification, rendered from the frozen package (notebooks/results), copied into the run
